user.description: Choose a meter or set it up later. Configuration and firmware builds require an installed ESPHome Device Builder app (stable, beta, or dev).

no_device_builder.title: Install ESPHome Device Builder
no_device_builder.description:
No supported ESPHome Device Builder app was found. In Home Assistant OS, open **Settings → Apps → Install app**, find **ESPHome Device Builder** (stable, beta, or dev), then select **Install** and **Start**. See the [ESPHome installation guide]({installation_url}) for the app link and repository setup if it is not listed.

Return here and submit to check again. Or choose **Continue without Device Builder** for calibration-only use; configuration editing, compilation, and OTA installation through the Helper require a supported Home Assistant app.

device_builder.title: Choose ESPHome Device Builder
device_builder.description: Multiple Device Builder apps are installed. Choose which one the Helper should use for configuration, compiling, and OTA installation. Start the chosen app before building. You can change this later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to discover Device Builder apps. Check Supervisor and try again.
error.device_builder_not_installed: The chosen Device Builder is no longer installed. Choose an installed app.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper entry is allowed.

init.title: ESPHome Device Builder
init.description: Choose the installed app to use for configuration, compiling, and OTA installation. Start the chosen app before building. Saving a different selection reloads the Helper; finish any active calibration or build first. Initial USB installation still uses CircuitSetup's prebuilt firmware.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to discover Device Builder apps. Check Supervisor and try again.
error.device_builder_not_installed: The chosen Device Builder is no longer installed. Choose an installed app.

abort.no_device_builder: No supported ESPHome Device Builder app is installed. In Home Assistant OS, open **Settings → Apps → Install app**, find **ESPHome Device Builder** (stable, beta, or dev), then select **Install** and **Start**. The [ESPHome installation guide]({installation_url}) includes the app link and repository setup if it is not listed. Then reload the Helper integration and reopen Configure.

abort.see_panel: Review the meter configuration and correct the invalid values before trying again. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Review the meter configuration and migrate legacy totals before relying on aggregate readings. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Review the saved voltage references and the meter configuration before applying changes. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Reconnect the meter and verify the configured aggregate entities after installation. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.

Start the selected ESPHome Device Builder app and reload the Helper integration. If no app is installed, open Settings → Apps → Install app and install ESPHome Device Builder; see the [installation guide]({installation_url}). Choose the app under Settings → Devices & services → CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper → Configure, then return to the Helper to retry.
Review the project name and configured package list before writing configuration. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.

runtime_entity_count_mismatch.title: Runtime meter entity count is unexpected

abort.see_panel: Reconnect the configured meter and confirm its discovered entity count. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Install the matching calibration package for every configured add-on. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Update the meter firmware to an API-ready calibration package. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.

ct_preset_metadata_diverged.title: CT preset metadata differs from the meter config

abort.see_panel: Review the configured CT gain before applying a preset. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Review the saved transaction and restart the required build or install step. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
Reconnect the meter and verify saved calibration gains before continuing. Open CircuitSetup Energy Meter Helper to review this repair.
